attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Veterinary Medicine (RI Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs offered or approved by the Rhode Island VMA or other state VMAs, AVMA, AAVSB RACE, AAHA, other states' veterinary licensing boards, or approved schools of veterinary medicine
rules.new_licensee_rule: Veterinarians first licensed after May 1 are exempt until the next renewal cycle (April 30 of the next even-numbered year).
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation of credits; failure to produce it on Board request is grounds for discipline. A single 6-month hardship extension is possible.
rules.notes: 24 h in the preceding 2 years; max 8 h non-contact (online on demand, articles), live streamed with Q&A counts as contact; max 4 h business management, at least 20 h professional veterinary practice.
